note: Recast from the original new-species description in Ahmad (1965), Termites of Thailand, in English; it was published as Postelectrotermes tongyaii, new species, with a single alate holotype (taken at light), and the soldier, worker and nymph are not described, so only the alate is entered here. The original gives neither body length nor wing length, and the measurements cover only the head, compound eyes, ocelli and pronotum.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head reddish brown, postclypeus darker than the head, anteclypeus pale, labrum pale reddish brown, antennae pale brown, pronotum concolorous with the head, legs pale brown; wings hyaline, the costa group brown, media paler than the radial sector. Head semicircular behind the compound eyes, the Y suture distinct with its lateral arms reaching the ocelli. Compound eyes not perfectly circular, anterior margin straight, their distance from the lower margin of the head slightly more than half their long diameter; ocelli projecting, broadly oval, touching the compound eyes. Anteclypeus trapezoidal; labrum dome-shaped, wider than long, the anterior margin nearly straight in the middle. Antenna 18 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 about as long as segment 3. Pronotum wider than the head, flatly arched, anterior margin shallowly concave, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, sides weakly convex. Forewing media less sclerotised than the radial sector and lying closer to it. Tibial spur formula 3:3:3, the middle tibia with a distinct spur close to the outer apical spur — compared with P. militaris, the only other alate known from the same region, this species is distinctly smaller and its middle tibial apical spine stands closer to the outer apical spur.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Holotype alate measurements (mm): head length to the tip of the labrum 1.90, head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.36, head width 1.60; compound eye long diameter 0.44, short diameter 0.39, distance from compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.25; ocellus length 0.18, width 0.14; pronotum length 0.90, width 1.87. Wings hyaline, the costa and subcosta brownish, the costal margin with short hairs.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Holotype alate 1, Thailand, Ka-Chong, 1962-03-03, collected at light by M. Ahmad. The species is named for Chakratong Tongyai, Under-Secretary of the Ministry of Agriculture, Bangkok. Only the alate was known when the species was published; the soldier and worker are not described.
